messages:
Priya (Marketing): Quick check-in 1: planning to publish marketplace listing + joint HW partner announcement next Tue. Embargo is Tue 09:00 PT. Need final partner asset bundles, blog blurb, and marketplace SKU metadata by EOD Mon.

Jorge (HW Partnerships): AcmeCompute and IceChip confirmed. Acme needs a co-branded architecture diagram and a short customer quote. IceChip will provide logos + cert matrix. Asking both for a single zip with: logos (SVG/PNG), 1-line quote, integration notes.

Lin (Design): For the hero we need a 1200x630 png + 2 SVG variants. I'll make a template and drop into /assets/marketplace/partners. Can someone confirm preferred background (dark vs light)?

Ravi (SI): SI playbook updated with install steps and troubleshooting. Key snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/si/register -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"tenant":"acme"}'`  We also added a rollback section for connector installs. One SI asked for sample terraform module; I can include a minimal example by EOD Mon.

Priya (Marketing): Thanks. Also need SKU names for AWS/GCP marketplace and a 2-sentence product summary per partner. Marketing will own the blog + press release draft. Legal: please review embargo language.

Maya (Partnerships): Ops questions: 1) Who owns marketplace YAML metadata to push to AWS/GCP? 2) Can infra confirm peak RPS test window and rollback plan if marketplace listing spikes DB writes?

Alex (Infra): I'll own the metadata push to cloud marketplaces and coordinate with cloud-ops. Load test scheduled Sat 2770003000, ramp to 500 RPS for 15m. Rollback plan: disable write hooks, redirect catalog read to CDN, and revert SKU publish flag. RTO ~10-20m. I'll publish a 1-page runbook in #eng-ops and link here.

Jorge (HW Partnerships): One legal ask from a partner: can we include a short MSA snippet about support SLAs in the public listing? Legal previously said only summary OK. @Maya can we surface that to legal now?

Maya (Partnerships): Yes. Legal note: partner SLAs should be summarized only 0-30 words. No proprietary terms. Priya 1 please add a callout to the press draft.

Lin (Design): Uploaded placeholder hero + two banners to staging: /assets/marketplace/partners/staging/lin-hero-v1.png. Feedback welcome. Also added a dark-bg SVG set.

OpsBot: deploy-scheduler: Reminder: staging->prod cutover window set to 2770003600. Please ensure smoke tests are passing in staging by cutover + disable any time-sensitive promos.

Ravi (SI): Noting that one SI needs repo access to the sample terraform module. @Jorge can you request a service account?

Jorge (HW Partnerships): Requested SA and shared the access ticket: TKT-7421.

Priya (Marketing): Draft embargo and blog posted to Google Doc (link dropped in #partnerships). Waiting on legal redlines and partner quotes.

Maya (Partnerships): Two immediate blockers before I close the checklist: (a) partner quotes from Acme/IceChip (b) legal approval on embargo copy & MSA summary. If either misses EOD Mon, we'll push public publish to Wed. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done.

Alex (Infra): Confirmed I'll publish the marketplace YAML and run smoke. Runbook link will be in #eng-ops by EOD Mon.

Priya (Marketing): I'll aim for EOD Mon. Posting QA notes in the doc.

Jorge (HW Partnerships): Pushed a partial quote from Acme. Will chase IceChip for final wording.

Maya (Partnerships): Awesome. Thanks team. Final checklist I'll post here once all pieces are green. :rocket:
